title: No way to budget an irregular income
problem: Freelancers and commission earners say budget templates assume a fixed monthly salary, so the sheet is wrong every month their pay changes.
fix: Budget from a rolling 'income buffer': log pay as it arrives, fund next month from last month's actual income, and show how many months of buffer remain.

moment.who: A freelance designer who just got paid by one client
moment.where: At their laptop on the 1st of the month
moment.screen: Their bank app showing a smaller deposit than last month
moment.next_action: Decide how much they can safely spend this month

canva20.reason: Needs rolling formulas across months and a buffer calculation, not just a layout.

title: Couples can't share one budget
problem: Partners want one budget but separate accounts; templates don't show who paid what or each person's share.
fix: A 'paid by' column per transaction, configurable split ratios, and a monthly settle-up line that says who owes whom.

moment.who: Two partners who just moved in together
moment.where: On the couch, end of the month
moment.screen: A shared Google Sheet open on one phone
moment.next_action: Work out who owes whom for rent and groceries

canva20.reason: Split ratios and settle-up math need real formulas.

title: Setup is confusing and formulas break
problem: Buyers give up during setup or break formulas when they add a category, then see #REF! errors.
fix: A 3-step Start Here tab, categories managed only in Settings (named ranges), locked formula cells and a setup video.

moment.who: A first-time buyer who just downloaded the file
moment.where: At their desk right after purchase
moment.next_action: Enter their first expense without breaking anything

canva20.reason: Error-proofing and protected formulas take real spreadsheet skill.

title: Annual and irregular bills catch people out
problem: Yearly costs like car insurance or holidays blow up the monthly budget because nothing saves for them ahead of time.
fix: A sinking-funds tab that turns each yearly cost into a monthly set-aside and shows progress per fund.

moment.who: Someone who just got a $900 car insurance renewal
moment.next_action: Figure out where the money will come from

canva20.reason: Per-fund monthly targets need date math.

title: Hard to use on a phone
problem: People record spending on the go but the sheet is unusable on a small screen.
fix: A narrow 'quick add' input tab designed for the Google Sheets mobile app.

moment.screen: The Google Sheets app on their phone
